73 cm sahi nahi hai. Iska jawab hai 72 cm, kyunki taar poora kinaara banati hai, toh 2 × (27 + 9) = 2 × 36 = 72 cm; 27 × 9 toh andar ki jagah batata hai, taar ki lambai nahi. Yahan tak theek hai?
maine pehle chhota wala socha, phir bada

Achha, theek hai. Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki parimap kisi band shape ke poore kinaare ki lambai hai, jismein har bhuja ek baar judti hai aur andar ki jagah nahi aati. Rectangle mein lambai aur chaudai do-do baar aati hain, isliye uska parimap 2 × (lambai + chaudai) hai, aur square ka 4 × bhuja. Parimap se ulta square ki bhuja nikalti hai, aur lambai bhi pata ho toh rectangle ki chaudai, aur parimap se hi chakkaron ki doori aur taar ka kharcha nikalta hai. Tumne 480 m nikaal kar teen chakkaron ka kul parimap sahi kiya. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
